parsed.title: Daily Reading Streak
parsed.oneLiner: Maintain a daily news habit by playing quick games to earn News Credits for premium features.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e47)

newMechanic.name: AOL News Credits
newMechanic.description: A habit-building virtual currency earned through daily streaks and rewarded ads, used to unlock advanced summaries or ad-light sessions.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: AOL operates in a no-scarcity regime; News Credits create a value exchange to monetize non-paying attention via opt-in games.

parsed.trigger: A user views the Home News Feed and sees a new streak counter near the top stories.
parsed.eligibility: Non-payers and users who have not yet claimed their daily streak reward.

offer.title: Daily Reading Streak
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL to earn 10 News Credits.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a small, once-daily grant that rewards habituation rather than replacing the need for an ad-free subscription.
risks: Initial utility of credits is low until redemption features (like ad-light sessions) are fully rolled out.
Potential fatigue if the streak reward feels disconnected from core reading value.

newElements.change: Add a 'Daily Streak' progress bar card with a 'Claim Credits' button below the top stories header.

storyboard.caption: A user returns to the Home News Feed to browse top stories.
A new Daily Streak card appears, encouraging the user to maintain their habit.
The user taps to claim rewards, opening a Simula game invitation.
The user plays a quick 15-second mini-game with the AOL partner character.
The reward is verified and News Credits are added to the user's account balance.
